user.title: HA Tools Email
user.description: Adds HA Tools Email. After setup, open Configure on this integration to enter your SMTP server and password.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of this integration is allowed.
abort.already_configured: HA Tools Email is already configured.

init.title: SMTP settings
init.description: Password: {password_state}. Leave the password empty to keep the current one, or enter the name of a secrets.yaml key instead. The password is stored in Home Assistant's storage and is never shown again.

data.send_test: Send a test email before saving

data_description.default_recipient: Comma-separated. Used when a report or action has no recipient.
data_description.send_test: If enabled, settings are saved only after the server accepts the test email. With this option off, no test email is sent.

error.invalid_auth: The SMTP server rejected the username or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the SMTP server (check server, port, encryption and certificate).
error.unknown_secret: secrets.yaml has no key with this name.
error.password_required: Enter a password or a secrets.yaml key.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.save_failed: Could not confirm saved settings. Check storage and save again.
error.save_failed_after_test: The test email was accepted by SMTP, but settings could not be saved. Check storage; the test is not repeated automatically.

abort.not_loaded: HA Tools Email is not loaded. Reload the integration and try again.

energy_missing_grid_import.title: Configure an electricity import meter
energy_missing_grid_import.description: No electricity import meter is configured in Home Assistant Energy. Open [Energy settings](/config/energy) and select your import meter. Then check [Energy](/energy). This notice clears after the current configuration is confirmed.

energy_consumption_overlap.title: Device consumption overlaps grid import
energy_consumption_overlap.description: Current-day measurements show device consumption above grid import, or child meters above their parent. Open [Energy settings](/config/energy). Check duplicate meters and parent/child assignments. Compare sources that measure the same energy flow. Then check [Energy](/energy). Missing measurements do not confirm that the problem is fixed.

smtp_password_in_history.title: Change your SMTP password
smtp_password_in_history.description:
Before HA Tools Email 2.1.0 the SMTP password was saved through the `ha_tools_email.save_config` action. Home Assistant stores action data in its database, so that password may also be present in the database and in backups that include it.

Create a new app password with your email provider, enter it in Settings → Devices & services → HA Tools Email → Configure, and revoke the old one. This notice disappears once a password has been saved there.

email_native_auth.title: SMTP authentication failed
email_native_auth.description: A confirmed attempt reported an SMTP authentication failure. Check the account in integration settings. This issue clears after a later message is accepted by SMTP.

email_native_failures.title: Three consecutive failed email attempts
email_native_failures.description: Confirmed history records three consecutive failures. Check integration settings. No automatic retry is performed. This issue clears after an SMTP-accepted attempt.

reports_delivery_problem.title: A report delivery attempt needs attention
reports_delivery_problem.description: A report attempt failed, was partially accepted, or its outcome is unknown. Check report status and integration settings before sending again. An unknown outcome can mean that a message was already accepted: do not replay it automatically. This notice clears after a later report is accepted by SMTP or a notification service. Acceptance does not confirm delivery to the recipient.

send_energy_report.name: Send energy report
send_energy_report.description: Send one completed calendar energy report. The response contains at, result, channel and attempt_id. Acceptance is not proof of delivery; unknown outcomes are never replayed automatically.

cadence.name: Period
cadence.description: Daily, weekly or monthly. The default is daily.

date.name: Date in the report period
date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD in the Home Assistant time zone. The whole selected day, week or month must be complete. Omit to use the previous completed period.

targets.name: Channels
targets.description: List of persistent_notification, notify.mobile_app_name or email. The default is persistent_notification. Email uses the configured SMTP recipients.
